top_categories.workout_context: GFNY Florida Hardee's flat rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 84, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Florida Hardee's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Florida Hardee. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on flat, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At GFNY Florida Hardee, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Florida Hardee. Practice on flat: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 84 miles.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 84 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Florida Hardee's flat actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Florida Hardee. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 84 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.weather: October in Wauchula, Hardee County, Florida, USA. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Florida Hardee. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Florida Hardee’s 84 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 84 miles of flat in Wauchula, Hardee County, Florida, USA.
